description: `DocAccess` and the boundaries above it catch `Forbidden`, `Unauthorized` and `RpcClientError`. `GetDoc` can also fail with `DocNotFound`, so `useDocAccess` returns a `Result<Doc, DocNotFound>`, and reading `.title` off it doesn't type-check.

errors.message:
Property 'title' does not exist on type 'Result<{ readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }, DocNotFound>'.
  Property 'title' does not exist on type 'Failure<{ readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }, DocNotFound>'.

title: Until every error is handled, the data is behind a `Result`

description: Read through `Session`, a doc can still fail with `Forbidden` or `DocNotFound`: both come back in the `Result`. Forgetting one is a type error that names it.

errors.message:
Argument of type '{ DocNotFound: () => React.JSX.Element; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ValueTagHandlers<DocNotFound | Forbidden> & {}'.
  Property 'Forbidden' is missing in type '{ DocNotFound: () => React.JSX.Element; }' but required in type 'ValueTagHandlers<DocNotFound | Forbidden>'.

title: What's left must be matched exhaustively

description: Under `DocAccess`, the failure is `DocNotFound` and nothing else. An `Unauthorized` can't reach this component (`Session` caught it), so a case for it is a type error, not dead code.

errors.message: Type '() => React.JSX.Element' is not assignable to type 'never'.

title: You can't handle an error a boundary already caught

description: `Session` already catches `Unauthorized`, so a boundary inside it that lists `Unauthorized` again would never see one.

errors.message:
Type '[typeof Unauthorized]' is not assignable to type 'readonly [typeof Unauthorized] & { readonly AlreadyHandledAbove: "Unauthorized"; }'.
  Property 'AlreadyHandledAbove' is missing in type '[typeof Unauthorized]' but required in type '{ readonly AlreadyHandledAbove: "Unauthorized"; }'.

title: A boundary can't catch what one above it catches

description: A query lists its errors' schemas, like an `Rpc` does: they are its error type, and what a boundary's hook checks at runtime to know whether anything is left. `GetDoc` can also fail with `DocNotFound` and the transport's `RpcClientError`, so an Effect that fails with more than the list doesn't type-check.

title: A query declares every error its Effect can fail with

description: The root's client is built from the RPC client's layer. A query that needs another service (`Analytics` here) doesn't type-check at any boundary under it.

title: A query can only use services the client provides

description: A boundary that catches `DocNotFound` too leaves nothing, so its hook returns the doc itself: no `Result`, nothing to match. `useSession(docList)` is the same: `Session` and the boundaries above it catch everything `ListDocs` can fail with. This file compiles.
title: Once every error is caught, there is no failure to get
